source_title: ‘Slow Horses’ actor Christopher Chung joins Alfonso Cuaron’s series ‘Ascension’
source_excerpt: Actor Christopher Chung, known for his role of Roddy Ho in the spy thriller series 'Slow Horses', has boarded the cast of filmmaker Alfonso Cuaron's upcoming Apple TV series 'Ascension'.The Australian actor will feature as a series regular alongside actors Amanda Plummer, known for 'Run' and 'Butterfly Kiss', and T'Nia Miller, who has appeared in 'The Haunting of Bly Manor' and 'VisionQuest'. Details about their characters have been kept under wraps, reported Variety.The series will be led by Caitriona Balfe, with Bill Nighy also part of the cast.Inspired by Adam Nevill's novel 'Last Days', the series follows Rose (Balfe), a documentary filmmaker and recently divorced mother who begins working on a project about a mysterious 20th-century cult known as the Church of Ascension.While Rose, who is adept at uncovering other people's truths but struggles with her own, finds unexpected refuge in the cult's teachings, she soon discovers something more sinister beneath them, according to the official logline.Cuaron has co-written the series with his brother Carlos Cuaron, along with Natalie Erika James and Christian White, known for their work on 'Apartment 7A' and 'Relic'. All four will executive produce the project.James and White will serve as co-showrunners, with James also taking on the role of lead director. Balfe will executive produce in addition to playing the lead role.Cuaron will executive produce the series through his banner Esperanto Filmoj, which has an overall television deal with Apple.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
